value.rationale: Modulus three is the first nonbinary unit-group residue problem, requiring a nonprincipal real character. Mixed signs at a fixed valuation and persistent negative average despite adjacent reversals give structural information that cannot be read from the parity valuation-only theorem; this addresses a natural named residue-divisor comparison question.
